target.statement: CAKE(PR) achieves ARI 0.855 on the Iris dataset after filtering to the top 70% of points by CAKE score, using an ensemble of 20 k-means runs.
target.table_ref: Table 2, row IR, column CAKE(PR), metric avg ARI

compute.basis: Iris is tiny (150x4); 20 k-means runs plus pairwise Hungarian alignment and silhouette computation take seconds on a CPU, and the paper provides a pip-installable package and GitHub repo.

title: CAKE: Confidence in Assignments via K-partition Ensembles
